sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Inhale, Tactile), Fire Release, Water Release, Corrosive Branch, Stable

system.description:
You expel a corrosive cloud of mist from your mouth that begins to melt anything it touches, that lingers as a cloud of acidic mist. Creatures, objects and structures in range of this jutsu when cast, or that begin their turns in the affected area must make a Dexterity saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature takes half of 4d6 acid damage.

Success: Affected creatures takes half of 4d6 acid damage and suffer a -1 penalty to their AC until the beginning of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures take 4d6 acid damage and become Corroded..

Critical Failure: Same as failure and they also gain a rank of Deteriorate.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the size of the affected area by +20 feet. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the size of the affected area by +20 feet.
